# Material Icons

Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons

Importer source commit: `bd8cb85bd4bad964fe6918f79665bb40c3a8efef`.
Existing packaged assets are retained; regeneration uses this immutable revision.

The `cc_icon_*.xml` resources are converted from Google's filled 24px Material
Icons SVGs under the Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`). They are preview
assets, not extracted Xiaomi artwork. The conversion script is
`tools/import_control_center_icons.py`; icons are packaged locally, with no
runtime downloads. The existing device-center mark is not part of this set.
